description: This file contains a PHP class named 'Layout' within the 'Opencart.Admin.Controller.Design' namespace. It primarily handles CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for layout entities in the OpenCart admin panel, including listing layouts, editing, creating, and deleting layouts. The class methods interact with models for data retrieval and manipulate view data for rendering pages, and they manage URL parameters for sorting, pagination, and navigation within the admin interface.
